description: This file contains classes and methods for parsing XML suite information related to test configurations in an Android testing framework. It defines parsers for different test suite types (instrumentation, native, host) and handles common XML attributes.

classes.name: XmlSuiteParser
classes.description: Base class for parsing common XML suite attributes and selecting specific parsers based on XML tags.

classes.name: InstrumentationParser
classes.description: Parser for instrumentation test suites, handling specific attributes like package, runner, class, and target.

classes.name: HostParser
classes.description: Parser for host test suites, including class and jar name attributes.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Main method to parse an XML element into a test suite object, dispatching to specific parsers based on tag.

methods.name: _ParseCommonAttributes
methods.description: Extracts and sets common attributes for test suites from XML.

methods.name: _ParseAttribute
methods.description: Helper to retrieve and convert attribute values from XML elements.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Specific parse methods for each test suite type (instrumentation, native, host).
